jobs.title: Workday Software and Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Thales has been present in the Republic of Indonesia for 45 years in the defence, aerospace and space domains, delivering a wide range of civil and defence solutions that highlight our strong commitment to working with the Indonesian government and local stakeholders. In recent years, our innovative solutions in air traffic management systems and telecom satellites have further strengthened our presence in the country alongside our digital portfolio of solutions such as biometrics, data protection and cybersecurity now serving the needs of diverse customers in civil sectors.

We are seeking a passionate Software and Integration Engineer with knowledge in developing and integrating solutions on the Workday Extend and Integration platform. You will join our dynamic team and actively contribute to the design, optimization, and maintenance of Workday systems used by the company. As an engineer, you will be involved in all stages of the project lifecycle, from design to production, ensuring high-quality, performant, and secure applications.

Responsibilities:
• Design, configure, test, and maintain solutions on the Workday Extend and Integration platform.
• Collaborate with product teams and stakeholders to understand business requirements and propose suitable technical solutions.
• Maintain and optimize existing Workday Extend applications and Workday Integrations
• Analyze performance and troubleshoot technical issues related to Workday applications.
• Follow Workday configuration best practices.
• Write and maintain technical documentation.
• Write, maintain and execute test scenarios for the purpose of testing Workday new Releases

Required Skills and Experience

Technical Skills:
• 2-3 years of experience in maintaining / implementing solutions on Workday
• Proficiency in programming languages: XSLT, JSON, Workday Studio, EIB (Enterprise Interface Builder), Workday Web Services (WWS) and REST API, JavaScript, Workday Extend Development.
• Strong understanding of Workday architecture and its ecosystem (HCM, Finance, Payroll, etc.).
• Familiarity with integration systems and APIs.
• Strong understanding of Workday architecture and its ecosystem (HCM, Payroll, etc.).
• Strong knowledge of Workday Reporting for end users (standard & advanced Report / Calculated Fields etc.)
• Knowledge of configuring any other Workday domain is a bonus
• Familiar with Workday Object Transporter

Functional Skills:
• Understanding of Workday business processes
• Ability to analyze functional requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Experience with integrations between Workday and other enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, etc.).

Interpersonal Skills:
• Strong communication skills to work effectively with teams and non-technical stakeholders.
• Problem-solving skills and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
• Organized, detail-oriented, and able to meet tight deadlines.
• Ability to work independently while being proactive in suggesting improvements within the team.
• Ability to work in an agile (scrum) environment.

Qualifications and Education:
• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Related Workday certifications or training (if available) would be a plus.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

jobs.title: Dynamics 365 CRM Technical Lead (Jakarta, ID, 12190)
jobs.description:
About EY

EY is a global leader in assurance, consulting, strategy, tax, and transaction services, operating in more than 150 countries worldwide. We help organizations navigate transformation, unlock growth opportunities, and build long-term value for stakeholders.

At EY, our purpose is to build a better working world. We are committed to helping our clients create sustainable value for people, society, and the broader economy while fostering trust and confidence in capital markets.

Our people are at the center of everything we do. Through continuous learning, diverse experiences, and innovative technology, we empower our professionals to develop exceptional careers while making a meaningful impact. Regardless of when you join us or how long you stay, the exceptional EY experience is designed to last a lifetime.

If you're looking for an organization where your ideas matter, your growth is prioritized, and your contributions create real business impact, then EY is the place for you.
Dynamics 365 CRM Solution Architect

Location: Jakarta, Indonesia
Experience: 12+ Years
Level: Manager / Senior Manager
The Opportunity

As a Dynamics 365 CRM Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in leading enterprise-scale CRM transformation initiatives powered by Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) and the Microsoft Power Platform.

You will work closely with executive stakeholders, business leaders, and technology teams to shape CRM strategies, define solution roadmaps, architect scalable enterprise solutions, and ensure successful delivery across complex business environments.

This is a highly visible leadership position within our Consulting practice, providing the opportunity to drive transformative client engagements, influence digital transformation programs, and develop market-leading CRM capabilities.
Your Key Responsibilities

You will collaborate with a diverse range of clients and colleagues to deliver innovative CRM solutions and enterprise transformation programs, including:
• Lead end-to-end design and delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions across complex enterprise programs.
• Architect scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions aligned with business and technology strategies.
• Define and govern CRM architecture standards, implementation best practices, and quality frameworks.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to define CRM vision, digital roadmaps, and transformation initiatives.
• Provide technical leadership across multiple projects and workstreams while ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and delivery quality.
• Oversee CRM application design, integrations, data migration strategies, and enterprise architecture alignment.
• Mentor technical teams and solution consultants while fostering innovation and continuous improvement.
• Support pre-sales activities including solution design, effort estimations, proposal development, client presentations, and demonstrations.
• Identify and drive business development opportunities, including account expansion, pipeline growth, and cross-selling of CRM and related Microsoft solutions.
• Build and maintain strong executive-level client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor in CRM transformation programs.
• Drive proactive risk management, issue resolution, governance, and stakeholder communications throughout engagements.
• Support decision-making, resource management, delivery governance, and team leadership activities.
Skills and Attributes for Success

To thrive in this role, you should possess the following:
• Strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Marketing, Customer Insights, and Omnichannel capabilities).
• Deep understanding of CRM architecture, solution design, customization, configuration, and extensibility.
• Extensive hands-on experience designing enterprise-grade solutions using Microsoft Power Platform.
• Strong experience in systems integration, data migration, API design, and enterprise architecture.
• Proven ability to lead large-scale programs and manage distributed delivery teams.
• Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
• Experience balancing business priorities, technical excellence, and commercial objectives.
• Experience working in Agile, Scrum, DevOps, and modern software delivery methodologies.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with focus on scalability, performance, and business value realization.
• Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into technology solutions.
Required Experience
Must Have
• Minimum 12+ years of experience in CRM, enterprise applications, digital transformation, or consulting environments.
• Minimum 8+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics CRM / Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement.
• Minimum 5+ years serving as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Technical Lead, or equivalent leadership role.
• Proven experience leading at least 3 large-scale enterprise Dynamics 365 CRM implementations.
• Demonstrated experience managing senior stakeholders across business and technology functions.
• Experience delivering multi-country, multi-business-unit, or large-scale enterprise transformation programs.
Deep Expertise In
Microsoft Dynamics 365
• Dynamics 365 Sales
• Dynamics 365 Customer Service
• Dynamics 365 Field Service
• Dynamics 365 Customer Insights
• Omnichannel Engagement
Microsoft Power Platform
• Power Apps
• Power Automate
• Dataverse
• Power BI
Technical Architecture
• Azure Integration Services
• API Management
• Logic Apps
• Azure Functions
• Service Bus
• REST APIs
• C#
• JavaScript
• Plugin Development
What We Look For

We are looking for passionate professionals who combine strong technical expertise with strategic consulting capabilities. The ideal candidate is a leader who can navigate complex business challenges, influence stakeholders, and deliver enterprise-scale CRM transformation programs that create measurable business impact.

You should have a genuine passion for innovation, digital transformation, customer experience, and helping organizations realize the full value of Microsoft technologies.

If you are excited about building modern CRM ecosystems, influencing enterprise architecture decisions, and leading high-performing teams, this role is for you.
What We Offer
Continuous Learning

Develop the mindset and skills needed to navigate an increasingly complex and technology-driven world. Gain access to world-class learning opportunities, certifications, and professional development programs.
Success as Defined by You

We'll provide the tools, flexibility, and support needed to help you build a career that aligns with your ambitions while creating meaningful impact for clients and communities.
Transformative Leadership

Receive coaching, mentoring, and leadership development opportunities designed to help you become the leader the future demands.
Cutting-Edge Technology Exposure

Work with leading cloud, CRM, AI, and digital transformation technologies while solving complex challenges for some of the world's most recognized organizations.
Diverse and Inclusive Culture

Be part of an environment where your unique perspective is welcomed and valued, and where collaboration and innovation drive success.
Global Opportunities

Leverage EY's global network of professionals, methodologies, and industry expertise to broaden your experience and accelerate your career.

If you meet the criteria outlined above, we encourage you to apply and join EY in helping organizations transform the way they engage customers, empower employees, and drive sustainable business growth.

EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and special needs. If you require assistance during the recruitment process or need accommodation for an interview, our Talent Team will be happy to support you.

jobs.title: Implementation and Technical Support Jakarta
jobs.description:
⚡ ABOUT D-EDGE

Have you ever booked a hotel online? Then you’ve probably used D-EDGE without knowing it.

🚀 Every day, we help more than 17,000 hotels worldwide to develop their online visibility and sales through leading-edge cloud-based e-commerce solutions. As a subsidiary of the Accor group, D-EDGE simplifies the life of independent hotels and hotel chains alike.

📊 D-EDGE Is the European No1 and World No3 hotel distribution technology provider in hospitality. With a team of more than 500 experts located in over 20 countries, D-EDGE provides localized support, services, and tools. With its global network of 500+ partners, D-EDGE’s ever-expanding ecosystem is a positive place to do business and grow.

At D-EDGE we are driven by these 4 key values:

💜 We care about people #PEOPLE FIRST
📣 We dare to share #OPEN COMMUNICATION
🤗 We embrace change #ADAPTABILITY
🤝🏻 We go the extra mile #GO BEYOND

🎯 WHAT YOU'LL DO

The Implementation & Technical Support Specialist is a hybrid role dedicated to the end-to-end success of D-EDGE customers. You are responsible for the seamless technical activation of the D-EDGE Suite (Implementation) and providing high-level technical resolution for existing clients (Technical Support). As a key member of the Client Service team, you act as the face of the company during the critical first phase of the customer journey and remain their primary technical advocate for troubleshooting and platform optimization.

Primary responsibilities

Implementation :

● Own the end-to-end activation process for all D-EDGE products, ensuring strict adherence to guidelines, checklists, and SLAs.

● Collaborate with Sales and Account Managers to build the client’s ecosystem, including room/rate configuration and connectivity setups.

● Set-up products included in the contract for the clients

● Define implementation timelines and record all activation statuses accurately within Salesforce CRM.

● Log tickets properly in Salesforce CRM for all issues encountered during activation/ implementation in order to help the Level1 with the resolution

● Design and lead bespoke training sessions (online or on-site) to empower customers and increase their autonomy on the D-EDGE platform.

● Keep up with D-EDGE products and features evolutions as well as the market trends in the industry.

● Handle the client’s complaints and interact with the assigned Account Manager

Technical Support :

● Serve as the primary contact for technical requests, maintaining high availability (answering calls within 30 seconds) and a professional "D-EDGE" welcome.

● Create / Take ownership of cases in Salesforce proactively

● Investigate, reproduce, and solve technical issues (e.g., overbookings, inventory discrepancies, or price synchronization) with a focus on speed and clarity.

● Proactively manage the lifecycle of a case in Salesforce, from initial logging to resolution or escalation.

● Perform deep-dive diagnostics (logs, reporting tools) before escalating complex issues to Level 2/R&D, ensuring a clear information trail is provided.

● Handle client complaints with empathy and coordinate closely with Account Managers to ensure long-term satisfaction.

● Train, mentor and shadow Junior colleagues, use acquired experience and knowledge to guide the junior agents.

KPIs

● Salesforce Individual : total of open/closed cases Team : CS total open cases/case age

● Talk desk (Number of answered/missed calls/SLA 30sec)

● Satisfaction surveys

● Internal case audit

● Consistency and quality of training sessions

Skills and Competencies

Technical & Analytical Proficiency

● System Investigation: Ability to read logs, use reporting tools for planning history, and accurately reproduce bugs in a test environment.

● Data Gathering: Expert at analyzing problems to obtain essential information (examples, timestamps, screenshots) required for deep-dive investigation.

● Technical Knowledge: Rapidly develop and maintain an excellent understanding of D-EDGE solutions and industry update processes (PMS, IDS, GDS).

● Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with a "detective" mindset to identify the root cause of complex technical issues.

Communication & Client Management

● Stakeholder Communication: Outstanding written and verbal skills; ability to translate complex technical investigations into understandable terms for non-technical hoteliers.

● Interpersonal Excellence: Proven ability to handle client complaints with empathy while collaborating effectively with internal Account Managers.

● External Coordination: Confident in contacting and managing relationships with third-party partners (Distributors and PMS) to resolve connectivity issues.

Workflow & Information Management

● Documentation & Research: Proactive in searching and contributing to internal knowledge bases (Wiki, Salesforce, Devnews) to ensure issues are documented and searchable.

● Escalation Discipline: Ability to provide structured, clear information when escalating cases through the proper hierarchy (TSS > L2 > R&D) without bypassing levels.

● Project Management: Organized approach to managing implementation timelines and activation tasks

Professionalism & Teamwork

● Autonomy: Proactive and capable of working independently while remaining a committed team player.

● Mentorship: Willingness to train and shadow junior colleagues to elevate the team’s collective expertise.

● Adaptability: Flexible mindset with a high level of attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

● Ability to work occasional [Weekends/Holidays] as required by the Regional Support rotation to maintain our high service level agreements.

Experience, tools and specialist knowledge

● Background in a B2B technology company or the Hospitality industry (Hotels, GDS, or OTAs).

● Advanced knowledge of Salesforce CRM, Google Suite, and Microsoft Office (Excel/Word).

● Rapidly acquire and maintain expert-level knowledge of the D-EDGE Suite and its evolutions.

● Prior experience in training or teaching is highly valued.

💜 WHY YOU WILL LOVE US

By joining us, you’ll find more than just a job — you'll discover a stimulating environment, a committed team, and a culture driven by innovation :

🤝 A caring and inclusive culture : respect, transparency, and autonomy every day.
🚀 A strong product vision powered by dedicated R&D.
🌱 A real commitment to responsibility
🌐 An international work environment : 45 nationalities, offices in 20+ countries.
📈 Genuine growth opportunities : Internal mobility, ongoing training, and tailored career paths.

Explore our Culture Book today and see if D-EDGE is the right fit for your career aspirations!

D-EDGE is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified candidates regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Apps Tech Specialist (ATS)
jobs.description:
PT Pasifik Cipta Mandiri (PCMan) is looking for an Apps Tech Specialist (ATS) who is passionate about application implementation, digital learning platforms, automation, and AI-based solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing, configuring, maintaining, and supporting software solutions for both internal and client needs.

You will work closely with clients and internal teams such as System Engineers, Developers, PMO, and Project Managers to deliver integrated IT solutions, including Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power BI, LMS platforms (Moodle/Open edX), and emerging AI solutions. This role requires strong technical understanding, adaptability, and a problem-solving mindset to support digital transformation initiatives across various projects.

Key Responsibilities

• Implement, configure, and maintain application-based solutions for internal and client projects.
• Manage and administer Microsoft 365, Power Automate, and Power BI solutions based on business and operational needs.
• Manage, maintain, and support Learning Management Systems (LMS), especially Moodle and Open edX.
• Provide technical support and troubleshooting related to application usage, system issues, and digital learning platforms.
• Work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into suitable technical solutions.
• Customize and support software applications to meet specific client or internal needs.
• Participate in the development, implementation, and integration of AI-based solutions aligned with company and client requirements.
• Support integration between applications and other systems to ensure seamless end-to-end solutions.
• Prepare technical documentation, user guides, system configuration records, and implementation reports.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders including system engineers, developers, and project managers to ensure successful project delivery.
• Stay updated with new technologies and continuously improve technical capabilities based on business direction.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
• Good knowledge and familiarity with Microsoft 365, Power Automate, and Power BI.
• Experience or understanding in LMS administration, especially Moodle.
• Development experience with PHP and Laravel framework.
• Development experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap Framework.
• Good understanding of SQL and relational databases.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Able to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications / Plus Points

• Experience in administering or implementing Open edX.
• Understanding of AI Engineer concepts such as Large Language Models (LLM) and tools such as Ollama.
• Familiarity with AI-related solutions or ecosystems from: (Microsoft, Huawei, BytePlus, etc)
• Experience in integrating AI with LMS platforms or business applications.
• Experience in building automation workflows using Power Automate.
• Experience in creating, maintaining, or developing dashboards in Power BI.
• Experience working with LAMP stack is a plus.
• Knowledge of hybrid mobile app frameworks such as Ionic and Cordova is a plus.
• Experience working with Moodle LMS implementation, configuration, or support is a strong advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, iOS
jobs.description:
About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Get to Know the Team

The MiniApp Platform team builds the technology that enables internal teams and external partners to create and operate MiniApps within the Grab ecosystem. We own the mobile SDKs, native entry points, backend integrations, developer tooling, reliability foundations, and self-service capabilities that help partners move from integration to production safely and quickly.

Get to Know the Role

As a Senior iOS Engineer, you will own and evolve the iOS side of the MiniApp platform. You will build reusable SDK and native capabilities, improve parity across iOS and Android, and help the platform scale from managed partner integrations toward a governed developer ecosystem. You will work closely with Android, backend, full-stack, QA, product, and partner-facing teams to deliver reliable experiences used across Southeast Asia.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
• Design, build, and maintain iOS SDK capabilities, native entry points, JavaScript bridges, and reusable APIs for MiniApps.
• Improve SDK reliability, performance, security, observability, and backward compatibility across Grab app releases.
• Drive iOS and Android capability parity by defining clear cross-platform contracts and consistent developer experiences.
• Partner with backend engineers on Horus services, authentication, scopes, transaction capabilities, telemetry, and other platform integrations.
• Build automated tests, release tooling, sample applications, and technical documentation that make partner integrations faster and safer.
• Investigate production issues, strengthen monitoring and failure handling, and contribute to incident response and post-incident improvements.
• Collaborate with product, design, QA, and partner teams to translate requirements into scalable mobile platform solutions.
• Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and continuous improvement of engineering standards.

What Essential Skills You Will Need
• At least 5 years of professional iOS development experience, with proficiency in Swift and the iOS SDK.
• Experience designing or maintaining mobile SDKs, frameworks, libraries, or platform components used by multiple product teams.
• Knowledge of iOS application architecture, lifecycle, concurrency, networking, persistence, and performance optimisation.
• Experience with WKWebView-based integrations, JavaScript bridges, RESTful APIs, and secure client-server communication.
• Understanding of API design, versioning, backward compatibility, testing strategy, and release management.
• Hands-on experience with XCTest, unit and integration testing, and CI/CD for iOS applications, frameworks, or SDKs.
• Diagnose complex production issues using logs, metrics, traces, Instruments, and systematic debugging techniques.

jobs.title: Teknisi Listrik
jobs.description:
Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan

Kami mencari Teknisi Listrik yang berpengalaman dan handal untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Futake Indonesia.
Sebagai Teknisi

Listrik, Anda akan menjadi bagian integral dari operasi teknis kami, bertanggung jawab untuk memelihara, merawat, dan memperbaiki sistem kelistrikan di fasilitas kami.
Posisi ini memerlukan keahlian dalam mengidentifikasi dan menyelesaikan masalah kelistrikan dengan cepat dan efisien, serta memastikan keselamatan kerja dan kepatuhan terhadap standar industri. Jabatan ini adalah pekerjaan kontrak yang berlokasi di Klaten, Jawa Tengah, menawarkan kesempatan untuk bekerja dalam lingkungan industri yang dinamis dan profesional.

Tanggung Jawab Utama :

• Melakukan pemeliharaan rutin dan inspeksi pada mesin-mesin produksi dan peralatan fasilitas sesuai dengan jadwal yang telah ditentukan.

• Mengidentifikasi dan mendiagnosis masalah teknis dengan peralatan, kemudian melakukan perbaikan yang diperlukan dengan cepat dan efisien.

• Melaksanakan pemeliharaan preventif untuk meminimalkan kerusakan peralatan dan memperpanjang umur pakai aset perusahaan.

• Melakukan perawatan harian seperti pembersihan, pelumasan, dan pengecekan teknis pada semua peralatan operasional.

• Mencatat dan mendokumentasikan semua aktivitas pemeliharaan, perbaikan, dan penggunaan suku cadang dalam sistem pencatatan yang tersedia.

• Berkoordinasi dengan supervisor dan tim produksi untuk memahami kebutuhan pemeliharaan dan memprioritaskan perbaikan darurat.

• Memastikan keselamatan kerja dengan mematuhi protokol kesehatan dan keselamatan kerja (K3) yang berlaku.

Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan :

• Pendidikan minimal SMK dalam bidang Teknik Listrik, Mekatronika atau Mesin.

• Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai teknisi maintenance atau dalam peran serupa di lingkungan manufaktur atau industri.

• Memahami listrik 1 dan 3 phase

• Memiliki keahlian Las/Welding menjadi nilai tambah

• Kemampuan untuk memahami dan membaca gambar teknis, dan manual peralatan.

• Keterampilan praktis dalam penggunaan peralatan dan alat-alat standar maintenance seperti multimeter, tang, obeng, dan peralatan ukur lainnya.

• Pengetahuan dasar tentang sistem mekanik, hidraulik, pneumatik, atau kelistrikan dalam konteks pemeliharaan industri.

• Kemampuan pemecahan masalah yang kuat dan perhatian terhadap detail untuk mengidentifikasi serta mengatasi masalah teknis.

• Sikap kerja yang proaktif dan responsif dengan kemampuan untuk bekerja di bawah tekanan dan menangani situasi darurat.

• Keterampilan komunikasi yang baik untuk berkoordinasi dengan tim dan melaporkan status pekerjaan dengan jelas.

• Komitmen terhadap standar keselamatan kerja dan kesadaran tinggi tentang risiko lingkungan kerja.

Tentang Futake Indonesia
Futake Indonesia adalah perusahaan yang berdedikasi untuk memberikan solusi teknis dan layanan engineering berkualitas tinggi di industri manufaktur dan industri. Dengan fasilitas modern di Klaten, Jawa Tengah, kami berkomitmen untuk menjalankan operasi yang efisien, aman, dan berkelanjutan.
Tim kami terdiri dari profesional berpengalaman yang bersemangat dalam memberikan hasil terbaik dan inovasi berkelanjutan. Kami menghargai keahlian, integritas, dan dedikasi dalam setiap aspek pekerjaan kami.

Futake

Indonesia adalah tempat yang tepat bagi individu yang mencari tantangan teknis yang berarti dan kesempatan untuk berkembang dalam karir di bidang teknik kelistrikan.
Lamar Sekarang

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

[What you will be working on]

As a Senior/Staff Software Engineer in Platform Engineering, you will be the principal architect for our multi-cluster container infrastructure. You will shape the technical direction of the core foundations that every Singpass product team builds upon—focusing on resiliency, security compliance, observability, and developer velocity at a national scale.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Resilience

• Architect Multi-Cluster Foundations: Design and evolve a resilient, hub-and-spoke multi-cluster OpenShift / Kubernetes infrastructure on AWS, optimizing for zero downtime, multi-region failover, cost efficiency, and performance.

• Advance Zero-Trust Infrastructure: Drive the implementation of Istio Ambient mesh, SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity federation, mTLS, and fine-grained authorization policies across complex network topologies.

Platform Engineering & Developer Experience

• Build Golden Paths: Enable product teams by transforming tenant onboarding and infrastructure management into self-service workflows backed by modular, reusable Terraform/OpenTofu code and clear reference architectures.

• GitOps at Scale: Standardize declarative continuous delivery using ArgoCD (ApplicationSets, multi-cluster synchronization) and modern CI/CD pipelines.

Security, Compliance & Governance

• Fortify Security Posture: Lead platform security assessments and penetration test remediations; integrate SIEM logging, privileged access management (PAM), and tight egress controls.

• Drive Technical Governance: Author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and technical RFCs, leading cross-functional architecture reviews to set technical standards across Singpass.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

• Build Engineering Capability: Mentor senior and mid-level engineers across teams, elevating technical craft, fostering shared ownership of critical systems, and cultivating a strong engineering culture.

[What We Are Looking For]

Technical Capabilities

• Scale & Expertise: 6+ years in software/platform engineering, with 3+ years architecting and operating mission-critical production Kubernetes/OpenShift (OCP 4.x) platforms used by multiple engineering teams.

• Service Mesh & Identity: Proven production experience with Istio (Ambient or sidecar topologies) and workload identity systems (SPIFFE/SPIRE or equivalent trust domain federation).

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Expert proficiency in Terraform or OpenTofu, with a track record of building reusable, well-documented module libraries adopted across organizations.

• Cloud & Networking Depth: Deep expertise in AWS enterprise environments (multi-account landing zones, VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, egress filtering, and managed databases).

• Modern Operations & Security: Practical experience with GitOps (ArgoCD), security remediation, SIEM integration, and architectural compliance in high-security environments.

Leadership & Influence

• Cross-Team Alignment: Proven ability to establish technical standards and build consensus across disparate teams via RFCs, architecture forums, and clear trade-off analysis.

• Documentation First: A natural habit of producing clear, accessible runbooks, system designs, and developer guides that scale institutional knowledge.

• Active Mentorship: Demonstrated commitment to growing engineers outside your direct team structure, helping them achieve measurable career progression.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with enterprise secrets management platforms (OpenBao or HashiCorp Vault).

• Exposure to distributed SQL databases (YugabyteDB, CockroachDB, or Google Cloud Spanner).

• Prior experience operating in high-availability, highly regulated environments (government, defense, or fintech).

• Hands-on experience with Reliability Engineering (SLO/SLI design, incident management leadership).

• Familiarity with guardrails and tooling for AI-assisted software development.

• Active contributions to CNCF or open-source infrastructure projects.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.   

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. 

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer Team Lead - Partner Systems & Integrations
jobs.description:
As the Staff Engineer & Team Lead for Partner Systems & Integrations within the Fleet Software Platform group in Singapore, you will lead the engineering team responsible for bridging Motional’s autonomous vehicle fleet with global commercial partner networks.

Moving beyond internal tool management, you will own the architectural strategy, B2B integration surfaces, and operational reliability of our partner-facing ecosystem. You will lead the effort to streamline integration interfaces and decouple internal tools from core fleet services—and lead an elite team of backend and full-stack software engineers to support 100x commercial scale in driverless operations.

What you'll be doing:
• People Leadership & Team Growth: Directly manage, mentor, and grow a team of senior and staff software engineers. Build a high-performance, inclusive engineering culture, manage performance, drive quarterly OKRs, and recruit top engineering talent across Singapore and global time zones.
• Partner Integration & Ecosystem Ownership: Serve as the primary technical leader and owner for all commercial partner integrations, specifically leading the design, execution, and scaling of core ride-hailing and fleet partner integration surfaces, dispatch messaging, dynamic operational design domain (ODD) synchronization, and trip matching.
• API-First Architecture: All applications sit atop versioned Fleet Orchestration and Vehicle Control APIs. Enforce clear separation of concerns by ensuring partner-specific business logic remains encapsulated within integration layers without bleeding into core internal platform services.
• Remote Customer Assistance (RCA) & Telemetry: Architect and scale real-time partner support capabilities, including multi-camera video streaming, real-time two-way audio communication between riders and support agents, and remote vehicle command APIs.
• Operational Excellence & Partner SLAs: Elevate system reliability to maintain high availability across all external partner endpoints. Implement enterprise-grade observability, automated incident management systems, zero-downtime deployment pipelines, and robust data security and access control standards.
• Cross-Functional & Partner Leadership: Act as the technical primary point of contact collaborating directly with external partner engineering teams, Product Management, Autonomy, Operations, and internal Developer Platform groups

What we're looking for:
• Experience: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years of direct people management
• Backend Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Golang or Python for high-throughput microservices, event-driven architectures (EDA) and gRPC/REST API design.
• B2B & Partner API Systems: Proven track record of architecting, launching, and operating mission-critical B2B partner integrations or public-facing API platforms with strict 99.99% SLA requirements.
• Cloud & Security Architecture: Strong experience with AWS cloud-native services (EKS/Kubernetes, ECS, Lambda, API Gateways, DynamoDB/Redis), Infrastructure-as-Code, and security frameworks for handling restricted PII data.
• Leadership & Execution: Demonstrated success in managing software delivery cycles, driving technical roadmaps, coaching staff-level engineers, and resolving complex, cross-functional organizational dependencies.

Bonus points (not required):
• Prior experience in the Autonomous Vehicle (AV), Ride-Hailing/Mobility (e.g., Uber, Lyft, Grab), or IoT Fleet Management sectors.
• Hands-on experience with real-time video/audio streaming infrastructure (WebRTC media servers, Ant-Media).
• Experience operating cross-regional engineering escalation rotations and live operations support across time zones (US/Singapore).

Why you should join us:

Join a high-impact team at the forefront of the commercial driverless revolution. In this role, you will lead an exceptional engineering team in Singapore, partner directly with global transportation leaders, and build the B2B integration platform that powers Motional's commercial autonomous fleet at global scale.

Eagle Wireless, headquartered in the United States, is the first Western supplier of IoT and automotive connectivity modules with engineering and manufacturing operations across North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.

We develop secure, high-performance cellular connectivity solutions for automotive, industrial IoT, smart city, and enterprise applications, serving both global enterprises and innovative startups. • Work with a global engineering team across the US, Europe and Asia-Pacific

• Clear career progression and technical leadership opportunities

We are looking for an experienced Senior Embedded Software Engineer to lead the design and development of embedded software for our next-generation IoT and automotive connectivity solutions.

In this role, you'll architect embedded systems, solve complex technical challenges, mentor engineers, and collaborate closely with Product Management, Hardware, Test Engineering, and Field Application Engineering teams throughout the complete product development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop embedded software solutions on Linux and RTOS platforms using C/C++.

• Architect scalable, maintainable, and high-performance embedded software systems.

• Lead software development from architecture and implementation through testing, integration, deployment, and maintenance.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into technical solutions.

jobs.description:
Front End Web Developer

REMOTE | Full-Time | Reports to Ecommerce Manager

JOB SUMMARY

As we continue to grow our portfolio of brands, we are looking for a skilled, detail-oriented Front End Web Developer to join our team remotely. This role supports day-to-day ecommerce operations across our 6 Shopify storefronts, company Wix website, and additional custom sites, working closely with our Ecommerce Manager and serving as an internal resource alongside our external development agency.

The ideal candidate is technically capable, highly organized, and comfortable shifting between front-end development, site quality assurance, content operations, and accessibility work. This is a hands-on role with real ownership across several web properties. You will be the person who catches issues before they become problems, keeps our sites running cleanly, and fills in the gaps that keep our ecommerce engine moving.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Front End Development and Site Ownership

• Own all updates and maintenance for our Wix company website and additional custom sites (such as our parts website), handling front-end edits, content updates, and ongoing upkeep

• Build custom landing pages across Shopify and Wix using a combination of custom HTML/CSS and existing Shopify sections, delivering on-brand, functional pages.

• Implement responsive, mobile-first front-end updates across all web properties, consistent with each brand's visual identity and standards

• Ensure all owned sites reflect current brand standards and are free of errors, broken links, and outdated content

• Serve as an internal support resource alongside our external development agency, helping manage and track tasks, filling in on smaller work items, and reducing agency dependency for quick fixes

• Act as a first line of response for emergency front-end errors on Shopify storefronts, resolving straightforward issues directly without escalating to the agency

• Provide an extra layer of QC and testing on Shopify development work before changes go live, catching issues early and communicating clearly with the agency when revisions are needed

• Help the Ecommerce Manager stay organized on active development projects by tracking task status, flagging blockers, and following up on open items in Asana and Notion

Site QC and Monitoring

• Conduct regular quality checks across all storefronts and web properties to identify broken links, display errors, layout issues, and functionality gaps

• Monitor site performance and surface improvement opportunities to the Ecommerce Manager

• Perform cross-browser and cross-device testing to ensure a consistent, error-free experience for all users

• Document and track identified issues in Asana or Notion, following up to confirm resolution

ADA and Accessibility

• Implement front-end accessibility fixes in line with WCAG 2.1 AA standards, including color contrast, keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, and semantic HTML

• Audit pages for accessibility compliance and prioritize remediation in coordination with the Ecommerce Manager

• Stay current on ADA compliance requirements as they apply to ecommerce websites

Shopify Admin and Content Operations

• Edit products in Shopify & Salsify, including but not limited to descriptions, images, and meta fields.

• Build and manage collection pages, including rules-based and manual collections

• Create and publish blog content within Shopify, formatting posts and applying appropriate tagging and categorization

• Make content updates and layout adjustments using Shopify's theme customizer, including banners, sections, and promotional content

• Customize and maintain Shopify transactional notification emails, including order confirmation, shipping, and other customer-facing templates

• Maintain accuracy and consistency across all product and content entries, upholding brand standards and internal SOPs

QUALIFICATIONS

• 2 or more years of hands-on experience with Shopify, including theme customization using Liquid and familiarity with the Shopify admin

• Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; comfort editing and writing front-end code independently

• Experience with Shopify admin operations including products, collections, blogs, notification email templates, and the theme customizer

• Experience managing or updating Wix websites

• Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and the ability to implement code-level fixes

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify, document, and communicate site errors clearly
Experience working alongside or supporting an external development agency
• - comfortable reviewing work, managing task flow, and flagging issues

• Proficient in Asana and Notion for task management and project tracking

• Self-directed and able to manage multiple concurrent responsibilities in a fully remote environment

• Excellent written communication skills for async collaboration across internal teams and external partners

• PLUS: Familiarity with cookie consent platforms (OneTrust, Cookiebot, or similar) and the ability to test and manage consent banners and privacy configurations on site

• A solutions-oriented mindset, when something is broken, this person fixes it

• Remote work arrangement

jobs.title: Project Based Front-End Web Developer
jobs.description:
Project-Based Front-End Web Developer

Remote – Philippines | Independent Contractor | Project Budget: AUD $2,000, subject to discussion

At Smart Suites, we have built more than just vacation stays—we create seamless and memorable guest experiences.

We manage more than 100 short-term rental accommodations across Rocklea, Sunnybank, Acacia Ridge, Kuraby, and other locations in Queensland, Australia. Everything we do is guided by our values of Customer Obsession, Ownership, Curiosity, Humility, Efficiency, and Teamwork—COCHET.

We are now ready to transform our online presence, and we are looking for an experienced Project-Based Front-End Web Developer to help bring that vision to life.

The Mission

Our current website is hosted on Lodgify’s proprietary platform. We are moving to WordPress to create a faster, more flexible, user-friendly, and scalable website that better represents the Smart Suites brand.

This is more than a basic website transfer.

You will help reshape how guests discover our properties, explore their accommodation options, and complete their bookings online. You will be responsible for rebuilding the website in WordPress, integrating the Mews booking widget, preserving our SEO performance, configuring website forms and email delivery, and supporting the website through testing, deployment, and handover.

The finished website must be visually polished, mobile-responsive, secure, search-engine optimized, and easy for our internal team to manage.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Website Migration and WordPress Development

• Lead the migration of the Smart Suites website from Lodgify to WordPress.

• Rebuild existing pages, content, navigation, and functionality.

• Customize WordPress using Elementor or another approved page-building solution.

• Create reusable templates and components that can support future properties, landing pages, and marketing campaigns.

• Minimize downtime during migration and launch.

Front-End Development

• Develop and enhance pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other appropriate front-end technologies.

• Translate approved designs and content into functional, visually consistent web pages.

• Ensure the website is fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

• Ensure compatibility with Chrome, Safari, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox.

• Resolve layout, functionality, and performance issues identified during testing.

Mews Booking Integration

• Integrate and configure the Mews booking widget or booking engine.

• Ensure a smooth guest journey from property discovery to booking completion.

• Test the booking experience across devices and browsers.

• Troubleshoot integration errors, script conflicts, tracking problems, and display issues.

• Coordinate with Smart Suites and Mews support when required.

Forms, Email, and SMTP Setup

• Build and configure contact, enquiry, newsletter sign-up, and lead-capture forms.

• Set up SMTP or another reliable email delivery service.

• Configure automated confirmations, internal notifications, and spam protection.

• Test all forms and email workflows before launch.

• Ensure form submissions are handled securely.

SEO Migration

• Audit the current website’s URLs, titles, metadata, headings, images, and indexable pages.

• Preserve existing URLs wherever practical.

• Implement 301 redirects for pages with changed URLs.

• Transfer page titles, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, and other SEO elements.

• Generate and submit an updated XML sitemap.

• Review robots.txt and website indexing settings.

• Configure Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, or existing tracking tools where applicable.

• Identify and resolve broken links, redirect errors, missing pages, and post-launch indexing issues.

Performance, Security, and Accessibility

• Optimize images, scripts, stylesheets, caching, and page-loading performance.

• Apply appropriate WordPress security and performance practices.

• Improve mobile usability and Core Web Vitals.

• Apply basic accessibility practices, including proper headings, image alt text, readable contrast, form labels, and keyboard-friendly navigation.

• Avoid unnecessary plugins and scripts that could affect speed, security, or maintainability.

Hosting, DNS, and Deployment

• Assist with or manage deployment to the approved hosting environment.

• Configure the domain, DNS records, SSL certificate, and CDN services such as Cloudflare.

• Support the transition from Lodgify to the new live WordPress website.

• Conduct post-launch checks for booking functionality, forms, links, redirects, analytics, responsiveness, and security.

Testing and Handover

• Conduct functional, responsive, cross-browser, performance, and user acceptance testing.

• Maintain a record of issues identified and fixes completed.

• Provide documentation covering page editing, website administration, plugins, forms, backups, and basic troubleshooting.

• Provide a complete list of plugins, integrations, licences, credentials, and third-party services used.

• Conduct a handover session with the Smart Suites team.

• Provide an agreed post-launch support period for migration-related defects.

What Success Looks Like

By the end of the project, Smart Suites will have:

• A fully functional WordPress website.

• A responsive experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

• A properly integrated and tested Mews booking widget.

• Working enquiry and sign-up forms with reliable SMTP email delivery.

• Preserved SEO value through correct redirects, metadata, and sitemap configuration.

• A secure and optimized hosting environment.

• Verified analytics and tracking.

• Clear website administration and technical documentation.

• No critical broken links, booking errors, or major display issues.

• A website that has been formally tested, handed over, and approved by Smart Suites.

What We’re Looking For

Required Experience

• At least 2–4 years of professional web development experience.

• Strong experience building and maintaining WordPress websites.

• Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive front-end development.

• Experience using Elementor or a similar WordPress page builder.

• Demonstrated experience migrating websites between platforms or content management systems.

• Knowledge of technical and on-page SEO migration.

• Experience integrating APIs, embedded scripts, booking widgets, payment tools, or other third-party services.

• Experience setting up website forms, SMTP services, and email notifications.

• Familiarity with hosting, DNS records, SSL certificates, and CDN services.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across WordPress themes, plugins, scripts, and browsers.

• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work independently against agreed milestones.

• Good written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

• Previous work on hospitality, hotel, serviced apartment, vacation rental, travel, or accommodation websites.

• Familiarity with Mews, Lodgify, or similar property management and booking platforms.

• Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.

• Understanding of Core Web Vitals and website accessibility practices.

• Experience working with Australian businesses or offshore teams.

Nice to Have

• Experience configuring web servers and hosting environments.

• Knowledge of server security, backups, recovery, caching, and monitoring.

• Experience creating staging environments and managing controlled production deployments.

• Familiarity with Cloudflare performance and security settings.

• Basic PHP or custom WordPress theme development experience.

Project Details

Job Type: Independent Contractor – Project-Based
Location: Remote – Philippines
Project Budget: AUD $2,000, subject to discussion
Working Hours: Flexible. Smart Suites operates between 5:00 AM and 10:00 PM Philippine time, and availability will be required for agreed meetings, testing, coordination, and deployment activities.
Reports To: Project Lead / Management Team

How to Apply

Please submit the following:

• Your updated résumé or professional profile.

• A portfolio of relevant WordPress and front-end development projects.

• At least two examples of website migrations or third-party integrations.

• A brief explanation of how you would approach migrating a website from Lodgify to WordPress.

• Your estimated project timeline and availability.

• Your proposed project rate.

• Details of any expected plugin, hosting, software, or licence costs.

• Your recommended post-launch warranty or support period.

Portfolio required: Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate your ability to create websites that are visually polished, technically reliable, mobile-responsive, and optimized for performance.

If you enjoy combining strong front-end development with practical problem-solving and want to help transform the online booking experience of a growing Australian hospitality business, we would like to hear from you.

Pay: Php80,000.00 - Php86,000.00 per year

Benefits:

• Flexible schedule

• Flextime

• Work from home

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer – AI & Agentic Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Summary The Lead Software Engineer – AI & Agentic Engineering is responsible for the overall technical direction, architecture, engineering standards, and technology governance across all AICC products, and is the technical owner of the shared product platform components used by multiple products.

This is a cross-product technical leadership role. The Lead Software Engineer does not manage each engineering team directly but provides technical leadership, architecture guidance, engineering standards, and technical coaching to Senior Software Engineers and development teams across multiple products.

The Lead Software Engineer is the formal technical counterpart to the AI Division and to DevOps: defining how products consume AI capabilities, agreeing capability contracts, and defining production-readiness standards.

A key responsibility of this role is to drive the adoption of Agentic Engineering, enabling engineering teams to effectively use AI coding agents and engineering agents while maintaining high standards of architecture, security, quality, and maintainability.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not an AI research position. Deep model work is owned by the AI Division.

Decision Rights To function without direct reporting lines, the role holds the following explicit decision rights:

• Approval authority over architecture decisions recorded as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and technical RFCs.
• Authorities block a release on architecture, security, or production-readiness grounds, escalating to the Head of AICC Product when a business trade-off is required.
• Ownership of engineering standards that all product teams are required to follow.
• Ownership of the shared product platform backlog, prioritized jointly with the Head of AICC Product.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Strategy & Architecture
• Own the overall technical direction across AICC products.
• Define and maintain reference architectures and engineering standards.
• Lead major architecture and system design decisions; run the architecture review forum.
• Establish technical guardrails while allowing teams sufficient implementation autonomy.
• Review critical architecture decisions and cross-product technical dependencies.
Shared Product Platform Ownership
Own the technical direction and quality of components shared across products, including but not limited to:
• LLM gateway (routing, fallback, rate limiting, cost tracking, prompt/version management)
• Knowledge base / RAG pipeline used by multiple products
• Telephony and real-time media layer (SIP, WebRTC, streaming audio, ASR/TTS integration)
• Conversation/session state, event streaming, and integration framework
• Product-level AI evaluation framework and observability
Decide, together with the AI Division, whether a needed capability is built by the AI Division, built as an application-level component in the Product OC, or deferred.
Software Architecture

Provide technical leadership in distributed systems, microservices, REST and WebSocket APIs, event-driven architecture, real-time and high-concurrency systems, cloud-native and on-premise deployable architecture, data architecture, scalability, high availability, resilience, security, and observability.
Evaluate technical trade-offs across performance, complexity, cost, scalability, maintainability, deployment model (SaaS vs on-premise), and time-to-market.

AI Application Integration Architecture

Define how AICC products consume AI capabilities provided by the AI Division and third-party providers:
• Capability contracts and API design between products and AI services
• Latency budgets for real-time voice and agent-assist use cases
• Fallback and degradation strategies (model unavailability, timeout, quality guardrails)
• Inference cost management and cost-per-conversation observability
• Application-level guardrails, prompt injection defense, PII handling in prompts, transcripts, and logs
• Application-level AI observability (quality drift, latency, error, cost)
• Product-level evaluation architecture (golden sets, regression harness, LLM-as-judge where appropriate)
Work with the AI Division on model selection constraints, self-hosted vs API deployment for on-premise customers, and language-specific (Thai) quality requirements. Ensure AI solutions are production-ready with appropriate consideration for latency, accuracy, hallucination, security, reliability, inference cost, scalability, and observability.
Agentic Engineering Leadership

Drive the company's engineering transformation toward Agentic Engineering:
• Define best practices for Human + AI engineering workflows.
• Evaluate and recommend AI coding agents and engineering tools.
• Establish standards for AI-generated code, including review, testing, and validation requirements.
• Create reusable engineering workflows, prompts, skills, tools, and agent patterns.
• Guide engineers on task decomposition for coding agents.
• Establish security and governance practices for AI-assisted development (secrets, data exposure to external tools, license compliance), aligned with Compliance / Security.
• Monitor engineering productivity and software quality; prevent uncontrolled generation of technical debt.
• Coach Senior Engineers on supervising and collaborating with engineering agents.
Engineering Governance
• Establish coding and architecture standards and development best practices.
• Conduct architecture reviews and technical design reviews.
• Guide engineering teams on technical debt management.
• Define standards for CI/CD, observability, deployment, and production readiness in agreement with DevOps.
• Ensure compliance and security requirements are implemented as technical controls, in agreement with Compliance / Security.
Technical Coaching
• Mentor Senior Software Engineers across product teams.
• Support engineers with difficult technical and architecture decisions.
• Develop engineering capabilities across the organization; facilitate technical knowledge sharing.
• Promote engineering ownership and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong hands-on development background.
• Experience as Technical Lead, Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or similar.
• Strong understanding of software architecture and distributed systems.
• Experience with cloud-native technologies, containers, and CI/CD.
• Strong understanding of AI application architecture and integration of LLM-based capabilities into production systems.
• Experience using or integrating modern AI engineering tools and coding agents.
• Strong analytical and technical problem-solving skills.
• Ability to influence and drive decisions without direct authority.
Preferred Qualifications
• LLM application development, RAG, AI Agents / Agentic AI
• AI-assisted software development at team or organization scale
• Kubernetes, on-premise deployment, GPU / AI inference infrastructure
• Real-time systems, telephony, WebRTC, streaming audio
• ASR / TTS integration
• Enterprise software; Contact Center or Customer Experience systems
• Security and data protection practices (PDPA or equivalent)
• Contact Center domain knowledge is an advantage but not required.

jobs.description:
Company Description

SmartDev is an AI-powered software development company headquartered in Vietnam, part of the Verysell Group. We help global businesses deliver faster and build smarter — combining AI-driven development practices with deep expertise across fintech, healthcare, retail, and enterprise technology. Our team of engineers, architects, and AI specialists works across the full stack: from custom software and cloud solutions to generative AI, MLOps, and intelligent automation. At SmartDev, we believe that great architecture and AI-first thinking are a competitive advantage — and we build our teams accordingly.

The company is at a pivotal point in our journey: transitioning from a pure IT outsourcing provider to an AI-enabled solutions partner.

We have over 200 talented employees working both on-site and remote/hybrid at locations:

• Hanoi: Zodiac building, 19 Duy Tan Street, Dich Vong Hau ward, Cau Giay District, Hanoi
• Danang: 81 Quang Trung, Hai Chau 1 ward, Hai Chau District, Danang

Job Description

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of high quality applications. You will apply your deep expertise to define architectural blueprints and develop viable solution options, ensuring they align with defined functional and non-functional requirements. You will play a key role in governance and quality control, actively guiding peers on best practices, and ensuring robust technical planning. Crucially, you will collaborate directly with other cross-functional technology teams to ensure smooth integration and deployment of full-stack solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive Technical Excellence by architecting, building, enhancing, and maintaining complex full-stack applications while proactively evaluating and integrating new technologies.
• Ensure Code Quality and Stability through rigorous code reviews and maintaining a stable, high-performance development and deployment environment.
• Full-Cycle Ownership including the analysis of business objectives to define and refine detailed functional and non-functional requirements.
• Design and Implement end-to-end technical solutions for both functional and non functional needs, focusing on scalability, security, and performance.
• Develop and Deploy high-quality, production-ready software solutions with comprehensive test coverage and minimal supervision.
• Master Cloud Architecture by designing and implementing low-latency, high-availability, and fault-tolerant applications within the AWS ecosystem, leveraging technologies like C#, .NET Core, Node.js, and React.
• Establish DevOps Pipelines by setting up and managing critical AWS resources, automating processes via CI/CD, and utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
• Mentor and Elevate junior and mid-level engineers by providing technical guidance, code assistance, and actively fostering their growth.
• Champion Collaboration by working proactively as part of a highly collaborative Agile team, supporting shared goals and influencing technical direction.
• Communicate and Influence clearly and effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, articulating insights, technical plans, and ideas to cross-functional teams and management.
• Own the Service Lifecycle (Build it, Own it, Run it) by taking end-to-end responsibility for the reliability, monitoring, and operational health of deployed services.

Qualifications

• Strong proficiency with the following languages C#, .NET core, React.
• 6+ years of experience in the IT industry, including at least 2 years delivering distributed solutions.
• Good knowledge of Microservices architecture and RESTful APIs
• Ability to design and build API-based and distributed, cloud-native solutions with AWS
• Experience working with RDBMS (Postgres or SQL Server)
• Experience working with automated testing frameworks
• Experience working with performance test automation tools
• Strong understanding of best practises, design patterns and standards
• Understanding fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
• Risk management and incident management knowledge.
• Working knowledge of front-end technologies, such as HTML5 and CSS3 and React.
• Understanding accessibility and security compliance.
• User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments.
• Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git.
• AWS certifications (nice to have)

Additional Information

Benefits:

• International working environment with AI-driven strategic direction.
• 20 days of annual leave – Hybrid working mode.
• Premium healthcare package with PVI and comprehensive annual health check-ups
• Competitive salary & 13th salary bonus
• Lunch allowance to fuel your productivity.
• Engaging company culture with fun activities
• Global collaboration – Work with both Vietnamese and international colleagues.

jobs.title: Backend Software Developer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world’s most complex technology estates. Learn more on dxc.com

DXC Vietnam has been recognized as one of the "Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2025" by HR Asia Magazine, highlighting its exceptional HR practices and 31-year legacy in the country. The company also earned the special "Most Caring Company Award" in 2025 for prioritizing employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive workplace culture.

We are looking for an experienced Backend Software Developer to join a business-as-usual (BAU) support environment. The role will support and resolve technical incidents, application issues, and data discrepancies, implement database and application-level enhancements, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives at both team and project levels.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise services and applications.
• Design and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and database objects.
• Support system and data integrations across internal and external systems, database objects, and automated processes.
• Ensure code quality through peer reviews, testing, and adherence to development standards.
• Troubleshoot data-processing issues, interface failures, and reconciliation discrepancies.
• Monitor application health, logs, and alerts using tools such as ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms.
• Collaborate with Business Analysts, Infrastructure, Deployment, and Operations Support teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
• Maintain clear and up-to-date technical documentation, including solution designs, deployment procedures, incident reports, and operational runbooks.
• Ensure solutions comply with organizational security, compliance, and regulatory requirements, including encryption, auditing, role-based access control, and data masking.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in development, deployment, and support processes.
• Participate in incident response and on-call support rotations.

Requirements To be a successful candidate for this role, you have:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
• A minimum of 5 years of experience in software development and application support.
• Experience in Insurance, Financial Services, AML, Compliance, or Risk Management systems is highly preferred.
• Strong SQL skills, including query optimization, stored procedures, DML, and DDL.
• Good hands-on development experience with Python and C#/.NET.
• Hands-on experience with REST and SOAP APIs.
• Experience working with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control tools, and enterprise tools such as Git/GitHub, Jira, Confluence, and ServiceNow.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
• Good English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment through daily communication, documentation, and stakeholder meetings.

Employee Benefits and Perks

At DXC Vietnam, we follow a people‑first philosophy, offering competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits that support your professional growth and personal well‑being.

• Attractive and competitive salary package
• Full salary‑based contributions to Social Insurance, Health Insurance, and Unemployment Insurance in accordance with Vietnamese law
• 13th‑month salary (guaranteed)
• Generous leave policy: 12 annual leave days, 6 personal leave days, 1 volunteer leave day, plus sick leave, maternity/paternity leave, and childcare leave.
• Premium Healthcare Insurance (1+1) for employees and dependents
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with confidential 1:1 consultation for physical and mental well‑being to support you and your family
• Access to the Well‑being Hub covering health, mental wellness, and financial planning
• Extensive resources to support your onboarding and continual development including DXC University and sponsorship for professional certification exams.
• DXC Recognition, our global virtual platform that fosters a culture of appreciation and celebration with real-time reward and recognition
• Opportunities to work on global projects, collaborate with international teams, and explore overseas assignments or relocation
• Special allowances and gifts (English/Japanese language allowance, wedding gifts, newborn gifts, etc.)
• Remote work support with a company‑provided laptop
• Annual team activities and company events
• A collaborative, inclusive, and international working environment that promotes knowledge sharing and continuous growth

How to Apply & Our Commitment to You

If you would like to be part of a culture that drives innovation, delivers results, rewards performance, and encourages ideas, please click “Apply Now” to submit your resume.

In return, we are committed to providing a hiring experience that is transparent, fair, and engaging. Interviews and onboarding are conducted online as part of DXC’s virtual‑first approach to work.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DXC Technology is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and celebrate diversity as a source of strength. We believe in bringing your whole self to work, and our company grows only when our people grow.

Reasonable accommodation for qualified candidates may be made in accordance with the DXC Accommodation Policy, including support for individuals with physical and mental disabilities.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf.

【IBMとRapidus、戦略的パートナーシップを締結、日本における先端半導体技術とエコシステムの共創を目指す】
IBMとRapidus株式会社は日本が半導体の研究開発・製造におけるグローバルリーダーを目指す取り組みの一環として、ロジック・スケーリング技術の発展に向けた共同開発パートナーシップを締結したことを発表。

Rapidusは、日本の主要企業からの賛同を得て設立された先端ロジック半導体に関する研究、開発、設計、製造および販売を行う事業会社です。本パートナーシップの一環として、RapidusとIBMは、IBMの画期的な2ナノメートル（nm）ノード技術の開発を推進し、Rapidusの日本国内の製造拠点に導入します。

この取り組みは、数十年にわたって培われた、半導体の研究・設計におけるIBMの専門性を活用するものです。2021年に、IBMは世界初の2nmノードのチップ開発技術を発表しました。このチップは、現在最も先進的な7nmチップに比べて45%の性能向上、または75%のエネルギー効率向上の達成が見込まれます。また、IBMは、先端ロジックおよびメモリー技術における日本の半導体メーカーや、日本の製造装置・材料のサプライヤー企業との共同開発パートナーシップを成功させてきた長い歴史を有しています。

本パートナーシップの一環として、Rapidusの研究者と技術者は、世界最先端の半導体研究拠点の1つであるニューヨーク州アルバニーのAlbany NanoTech Complexで、IBMおよび日本IBMの研究者と協働します。Rapidusは、IBM、Applied Materials、サムスン電子、東京エレクトロン、SCREEN、JSR、ニューヨーク州立大学（SUNY）を含む、Albany NanoTech Complexのエコシステムに参画する最新企業となります。

Rapidusは、自動化や効率化など、製造における差別化戦略を展開し、製品化のスピードと競争力の向上を図る計画です。また、この2nm半導体技術において市場をリードすることを目指すとともに、業界標準製品との互換性を持たせる予定です。Rapidusは、2020年代後半に2 nm技術の量産を開始する予定です。

システム室のリーダーとして、全社IT戦略の立案とメンバーの採用・育成を担います。

【先輩社員インタビュー】

▼自社事業の成長にダイレクトに貢献。全社が変わっていくダイナミズムを実感できます。

「前職のクライアントワークから『自社の成長に直接貢献したい』と考え転職しました。

【最後に】

「作る」よりも、「何を変えるか」を考える仕事がしたい。そんな社内SE・情シス経験者の方へ。

約3,000名・多角事業の全社DXを、経営のすぐそばで動かせるポジションです。

あなたの企画で、この会社の次の「当たり前」をつくりませんか？

年間休日124日・10日間の連休取得実績あり。長く働ける環境です

完全週休2日制（土日）と祝日、夏季・年末年始休暇で、年間休日は124日。5日以上の連休も取得でき、10日間の連休取得実績もあります。定時は17:45で、残業は月5時間以下。時間休制度もあり、平日の予定にも合わせやすい環境です。本社は東京メトロ銀座線「外苑前駅」から徒歩3分。カフェスペースやフォンブースを備えたオフィスで働けます。

jobs.description:
------------------------------------------------
■　この求人のポイント
------------------------------------------------ ソニーグループでIT活用の最前線に触れ、IT部門経営管理人材としてキャリアをさらに広げませんか？ 当社は、1988年にソニー株式会社の情報システム部門が分離独立する形で設立された専門会社です。先端のデジタルテクノロジーを武器に、ソニーの様々なビジネスをデジタル変革で牽引し、競争力強化に貢献しています。 今回は、事業拡大とグローバル体制の強化に伴い、経営企画・管理分野の経験者を増員募集を行うことになりました。IT×経営の新たな価値を共に生み出したい方をお待ちしています。 ------------------------------------------------
■　仕事内容
------------------------------------------------ 具体的には 【事業企画の立案】 • 中期計画・事業計画立案プロセスの運営 • 将来戦略を踏まえた課題抽出・提言のとりまとめ 【予実績管理】 • 管理会計等の実績管理プロセスの運営 • 月次予実績分析 • 課題抽出や現場等と連携した企画立案 ※そのほか特命事項への対応等もあり ＼グローバルなビジネス推進に携われる魅力！／ ソニーグループ全体のIT・DX推進に関わる経営企画業務だからこそ、グローバル規模のビジネス変革を牽引できるのは、この仕事ならではの魅力！ 海外拠点のメンバーとも連携しながら、各事業の成長戦略や経営課題にダイレクトにアプローチ。多様な文化・価値観と交わりながら、世界基準の意思決定に貢献できる環境です。 ------------------------------------------------
■　対象となる方
------------------------------------------------ ★海外も含めたグループ内の各拠点の活動を“見える化”し、顧客である各事業に対し透明性をもって説明・提言を行っていくのが、この部門のミッションです。5名ほどの管理会計チームで、経験を存分に発揮してください！ 【応募条件】 経営管理業務の経験がある方（予算立案・分析/予実分析） ※IT業界での経営企画・管理経験があれば尚歓迎！ Excelが使用でき、英語での業務対応ができる方（業務の中で日常的に英語でのメールや会議をします） 【歓迎スキル】 SAP（FI/CO/BO/BPC *user）などのBIツールの活用経験 ------------------------------------------------
■　勤務時間
------------------------------------------------ 09:00～17:45(休憩60分)　( 実働：7時間45分 ) ※フレックスタイム制もあり ------------------------------------------------
■　勤務地
------------------------------------------------ 東京都港区港南1-7-1 ※リモートワークあり ※将来的に会社の定める場所（出向、在宅勤務実施場所含む）へ変更となる場合があります マイナビ転職の勤務地区分では… 東京都 ------------------------------------------------
■　交通アクセス
------------------------------------------------ JR品川駅港南口 徒歩5分 ------------------------------------------------
■　給与
------------------------------------------------ 月給365,000円～536,000円 ※試用期間3ヶ月あり（待遇に変更はありません） ※経験・能力を考慮の上、当社規定により決定します 初年度年収 500万円～1000万円 ------------------------------------------------
■　昇給・賞与
------------------------------------------------ 【昇給】年1回（7月） 【賞与】年1回 ------------------------------------------------
■　諸手当
------------------------------------------------ 通勤手当 家族手当 残業手当 資格手当 赴任手当 休日勤務手当 夜勤手当 その他手当 ------------------------------------------------
■　休日・休暇
------------------------------------------------ 完全週休2日制（土・日） 祝日 年末年始休暇 有給休暇 慶弔休暇 出産・育児休暇 介護休暇 その他休暇 年間休日125日 ------------------------------------------------
■　福利厚生
------------------------------------------------ 【社会保険】 健康保険・厚生年金・雇用保険・労働保険：有 【寮・社宅】 独身寮あり、転勤社宅制度あり 【退職金】 有（確定拠出型年金） 【その他制度】 リモートワーク可※週3日以上の出社を基本として、週2日程度のリモートワークを組み合わせたハイブリットな働き方が可能です 育児・介護両立支援制度（短時間勤務、休職制度等） 研修支援制度 社員食堂 【兼業・副業】 可　※社内規定に基づき承認が得られた場合 【転勤】 当面無 ------------------------------------------------
■　経験
------------------------------------------------ 業種未経験OK

jobs.title: Associate Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
____
Why Snowflake ?
Snowflakeはデータ革命の最前線に立ち、世界最高のデータとアプリケーションのプラットフォームの構築に取り組んでいます。私たちのミッションはデータサイロ化を解消して、「世界中のデータをモビライズすること」を目指しております。急成長していくデータの未来を私たちと共に築いていきましょう！

Solution Engineering team’s Mission ?
Solution Engineeringチームは、営業チームやパートナーと密に連携しながら、お客様の課題を理解し、Snowflakeの価値をわかりやすく伝え、案件形成から技術検証、成約後の活用イメージづくりまでを支援する役割を担います。Associate Solution Engineerには、経験豊富なSEや営業メンバーと協業しながら、顧客への提案活動、デモ支援、技術的な学習と実践を通じて成長していくことを期待します。

The Impact You will Make
• 営業チームやSenior SEと連携し、見込み客や既存顧客に対するプレゼンテーション、デモ、技術説明を支援する。

• 顧客の業務課題や技術要件を理解し、Snowflakeの価値と結びつけて提案できるようになる。

• データ、クラウド、AIの進化を学び続け、競合技術や関連ベンダーへの理解を深める。

• 製品、エンジニアリング、マーケティングなどの社内チームと協力し、現場の学びや顧客の声を共有する。

• 日本のSE組織における標準的な選考・育成の期待に沿って、技術力、プレゼン力、顧客提案力を段階的に高めていく。

Who You Are
必須要件
• ITに関わる業務を3年以上経験された方

• SaaS、クラウド、データプラットフォーム、アナリティクス、AI関連領域に強い関心を持ち、継続的に学習できる方

• 日本語に堪能で、英語での業務に抵抗がない方
